usage: The word "天鵝" refers to a type of bird known as a swan.
"天鵝" is used as a noun when talking about animals, specifically birds.
You can use "天鵝" when describing wildlife, nature scenes, or in stories involving animals.
In sentences, "天鵝" usually acts as the subject or object, for example, 'The swan is swimming.'
It is common to see "天鵝" paired with verbs like '見到' (to see) or '游水' (to swim).
